messages.subject: CAR models and Distributions
parts:
I have a general question. 

Most the papersI come across ,have applied a Poisson distribution when smoothing using CAR models. Is it because it happens they have a count data only at their disposal ? OR there are problems when applying CAR models to data that have distributions eg gaussian

Thanks 
Pete

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] CAR models and Distributions
parts:
CAR models also 'works' with other types of data, just that
it is, perhaps most commonly applied to these kinds of data.

the model where the CAR model(s) is a part of, is kind of separate from
the likelihood model, as the likelihood model is just what it is, and
there to connect the 'model' to the data.
